import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    os = 0
    count = 0
    
    for i in range(len(str_input)):
        count += 1
        if i == len(str_input) - 1 or str_input[i] != str_input[i + 1]:
            if count % 2 == 0:
                os += 1
            count = 0
    
    print(os)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
